line.title: Enter Route Number
line.description: In {city_name}, enter the route number (e.g., 7, 368), then click Next to search.

direction.title: Select Direction

error.unknown: Unknown error. Check logs for details.
error.auth_failed: Client fingerprint invalid. May require updating the integration.
error.line_not_found: No bus route found for this number. Please check and try again.
error.no_stations: No stations returned for this route.

abort.already_configured: This route and station are already configured.
